thread:
Aria (Design): Quick concept drop 12: compact invoice list with left micro-sparkline, right-aligned amount, and a chevron to expand details. Figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz :sparkles:
Marcus (PM): Love the scanability. Two asks: easy Org vs Project switch and persistent invoice download at top.
Selene (Frontend): Agree, but touch target sizes are a concern on mobile. Make icons 36px hit area.
Carlos (Eng): Perf note: render sparklines as inlined SVG paths; virtualize the list. For expanded histograms use lazy-render.
Nora (Data): FYI most invoices <50 lines; we'll server-flag large invoices so client can auto-condense.
Aria (Design): Condensed mode copy: "Condensed invoice (for performance) 12 Show full details".
Marcus (PM): UX: when Org scope is selected should we aggregate by project or show project rows with filter?
Selene (Frontend): Prefer aggregate + a clear badge "Aggregated by project" with tooltip and an expand chevron to view projects.
Carlos (Eng): For nested lists, use proper tree semantics (role="tree") and aria-expanded on controls.
a11y-bot: Accessibility: ensure aria-expanded updates, focusable banner for condensed mode, visible focus ring, and respects prefers-reduced-motion. Sparkline contrast >= 3:1.
Aria (Design): Also add tiny trend percent next to sparkline (muted). Nora: can you confirm it's useful?
Nora (Data): Yes, anomaly detection uses that metric. We can include month-over-month pct.
Marcus (PM): Events to track: invoice.view.mode, invoice.line.expand, invoice.units.toggle. Keep payload minimal.
Selene (Frontend): I'll prototype keyboard nav (arrows to move, enter to toggle). Carlos will implement IntersectionObserver + requestIdleCallback for heavy renders.
Carlos (Eng): Yep. We'll feature-flag server-driven condensed mode for rollout.
Aria (Design): I'll update Figma with compact + aggregated variants and add a11y notes. Tagging @a11y-bot for checklist. :white_check_mark:
